shortDesc: A multi-handle hydro-dermabrasion system for water-bubble cleansing, oxygen infusion, RF firming, ultrasound and cold therapy at our Ahmedabad clinic.
intro: The Alice Super Bubble is the hydra facial system at Skin Essence in Ahmedabad. It pairs water-bubble hydro-dermabrasion, which loosens dead cells and impurities with a vortex of serum under vacuum, with oxygen infusion, radiofrequency firming, ultrasound and hot-and-cold therapy, so one session can cleanse, hydrate and firm the skin without downtime.

Its four labelled serum bottles feed the handpieces, and the dermatologist selects the steps for each patient's skin, from a clarifying sequence for oily, congested skin to a hydrating one for dry, dull skin.

howItWorks.title: Water-bubble cleansing
howItWorks.description: A vortex of serum and water under vacuum lifts dead cells and impurities from the surface and pores.

howItWorks.title: Oxygen and serum infusion
howItWorks.description: Oxygen and hydrating serums are infused into the freshly cleansed skin to brighten and plump it.

howItWorks.title: RF, ultrasound and cooling
howItWorks.description: Radiofrequency warms the deeper layers to support collagen, ultrasound aids penetration, and cold therapy calms the skin and closes pores to finish.

faqs.q: Does a hydra facial on this system hurt?
faqs.a: No. You feel cool suction and gentle vibration, and most patients find the session relaxing. There is no downtime.

faqs.q: How often should I have it?
faqs.a: Every 4 to 6 weeks keeps pores clear and the skin hydrated; a single session works well a week before an event.
